title: Verdant 39 — Crossings: Dirt, Sand, Stone, Water & Snow Transitions for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled & Godot [16x16]
shortText: Ground meets ground: dirt, sand, stone, water, snow and ash transitions for Verdant 01 and 03. MZ, Tiled, Godot.

metadata.assetLicence: Commercial use permitted, unlimited projects, no attribution required, no resale of the pack

description:
Ground that meets ground, with no strip of grass in between. 12 complete 47-mask transition sets for the Verdant 16x16 series: a dirt road onto a beach, a pond sitting in sand, snow on stone, ash on dirt. 592 tiles in one 29-colour palette. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

What is in it

  • 6 sets that complete Verdant 01: dirt on sand, stone on sand, water on sand, stone on dirt, water on dirt and water on stone. With Verdant 01's own four grass edges, every pair of its five grounds now has a transition.
  • 6 sets that cross Verdant 03 into Verdant 01: snow on dirt, snow on stone, snow on water, dune sand on dirt, ash on dirt and ash on stone.
  • 564 transition tiles, every inner corner, outer corner, edge, junction and single in every set, each edge drawn with a dark rim and a soft contact shade on the ground outside it.
  • 28 ground tiles, identical pixel for pixel to Verdant 01 — Overworld (16) and Verdant 03 — Worlds (12), so the new edges drop into a map built with those packs. This pack also works on its own.
  • A finished 40x28 sample map with every set on it and no grass anywhere, as PNG, JSON and a Tiled .tmx; tiles.json with every tile's role, sheet slot, mask and passability.

Engines

  • RPG Maker MZ: every set on the A2 sheet as MZ's own autotile brush; every shape was composed back out of the sheet with MZ's own autotile table (576 of 576 identical). Tested against the table, not inside the MZ editor.
  • Tiled: one .tsx per sheet; Tiled's own renderer drew the sample map identical to ours (1,146,880 px, 0 differ).
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (592 tiles built).

Nothing in this pack animates: the water is Verdant 01's still water.

Honest notes

Two of the pairs (water on sand and stone on dirt) can also be generated by Verdant Forge, the generator behind the series; they are here so Verdant 01's set of pairs is complete. Dune sand on Verdant 01 sand is not included: they are the same colour, so the edge drew only an outline.

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is exactly 16x16, every pixel is inside the palette, and alpha is strictly on or off.

AI disclosure

Every tile is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
